Zone correctness: the wearer's live "def_ignore" stat (per-actor query via live_buff_stats) is summed with ability ignore and passed as the defense_ignore argument of ntesim_core::combat::exact::evaluate_direct_damage -> defense_factor(level, defense, shred, ignore) = A / (A + DEF * (1 - shred) * (1 - ignore)), exactly COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 3. It is never added to a damage zone (M_bonus, final multiplier, special). Attacker-scoped: an ally hitting while the wearer's buff is live gets no bonus.

Independent numeric counterexample (new test lost_radiance_def_ignore_is_a_defense_factor_not_a_damage_multiplier): Lv80 attacker, B = 1400, target DEF 1080, no RES/crit; A = 600 + 6*80 = 1080. No ignore: F_def = 1080/(1080+1080) = 1/2, D = 1400*1/2 = 700. 25% ignore: DEF_effective = 1080*3/4 = 810, F_def = 1080/1890 = 4/7, D = 1400*4/7 = 800. A +25% damage-multiplier model would give 700*5/4 = 875; the test asserts 800 != 875. The ignore yields 14.2857% more damage (4/7 vs 1/2), not 25%.

Expiry and refresh: with a grant at t=15s, a melee at t=30s still gets the ignore (deadline 35s) and a melee at t=35s does not (800 -> 700 at the boundary); a second successful Ultimate admission resets the deadline (RefreshPolicy::Reset, non-stacking), matching "Effect does not stack".
